sn36.25:1.1: Imā vedanā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || ñāṇam udapādi || paññā udapādi || vijjā udapādi || āloko udapādi || || 5
sn36.25:1.2: Ayaṃ vedanāsamudayoti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || la || || 6
sn36.25:1.3: Ayaṃ vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadāti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || la || || 7
sn36.25:1.4: Ayaṃ vedanānirodho ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || la || || 8
sn36.25:1.5: Ayaṃ vedanānirodhagaminī paṭipadā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || la || 9
sn36.25:1.6: Ayaṃ vedanāya assādo ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu || la || || 10
sn36.25:1.7: Ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu || la || || 11
sn36.25:1.8: Idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi || ñāṇam udapādi || paññā udapādi || vijjā udapādi || āloko udapādīti || || 2
